p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: The buyer takes care of everything coming from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods with export clearance to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the ship; thereafter, risk and cost are of the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the shipping and insurance costs to the port of destination.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller supplies to destination, buyer pays import taxes.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import taxes.

p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the amount you got: fee + exchange rate, a rate worse than the market is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often an ID is required, both to send and to collect.

p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without a warehouse: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. Easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose the product that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("reward sales/supplier" listings here or reward sales platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Think about the real price: product, shipping, taxes, value added tax in the customer's country, payment fees and refunds.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, income tax and taxes according to your state (see Trade laws).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear pricing including taxes, right of refund, warranty, protection of information.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A vendor who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or cryptocurrencies.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich in no time.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel arriving from outside the Union pays income tax from the first euro.
